name: Candidate Population Lineage
description: A configurable multi-stage candidate lineage that visualizes population expansion and convergence while preserving stage counts, branch attribution, rejection categories, and keyboard-accessible selection.
whyExistingIsInsufficient: The communication Sankey explains many-to-many traffic between two endpoint columns. Candidate lineage needs an ordered sequence of stages, stage-local candidate populations, alternating expansion and convergence, and conservation checks across every adjacent stage.

validation.diverge: The target stage count must be greater than or equal to the source count, and branch counts must sum to the target count.
validation.converge: The target stage count must be less than or equal to the source count, and rejected counts must equal source minus target.
validation.segments: When supplied, stage segment counts must sum to the stage count.

allowedOverrides: diverge branches and converge rejection categories
container size through the consuming layout
forbiddenOverrides: embedding product detail panels or business narratives inside the pattern root
setting a component-local dark or light theme
recreating SVG geometry in a consuming page
restyling internal pattern classes from a consuming page
themeContract: The component contains no theme switch or fixed theme. It consumes PTO semantic tokens and follows the nearest calling document data-theme state.
agentReuseRule: Load pattern.css and pattern.js, mount one empty container, pass stages with each non-final stage's outgoing next operation, and use onSelect to render product-owned details outside the component.
previewGate: The user explicitly approved the extracted visual direction and onSelect-only integration on 2026-08-29.
